ai.title: readfiles accepts absolute paths and fixes result mapping
ai.summary: read_files tool schema now accepts absolute paths within project root, previously restricted to relative paths. get-file-reading-updates.ts switched from filtering requestedFiles to mapping Object.entries(loadedFiles), fixing normalized path mismatches. Affects common/src/tools/params/tool/read-files.ts and packages/agent-runtime/src/get-file-reading-updates.ts. Path normalization consistency ensured for agent file operations.

eli5.text: When you ask the assistant to read a file, you can now give it the full path to that file instead of only a shortened path, as long as the file lives within your project. Previously, if you pasted the complete path, the assistant sometimes came back empty-handed even though it had opened the file, because of a mismatch in how the two sides named the file. With the fix, the assistant now matches the file it just read to the one you asked for, so it returns the content instead of reporting it as missing. This behavior is live today for anyone using the assistant's file-reading feature.

ai.title: Freebuff 0.0.93 release bundles live stats cleanup and absol
ai.summary: This release bump to 0.0.93 packages two preceding changes: a UI cleanup in live-summary.tsx that strips the redundant sublabel and descriptive paragraph from HomepageLiveStats to reduce visual noise in the web live stats display, and a fix in the read_files tool schema allowing absolute paths within the project root along with a result-mapping correction in get-file-reading-updates.ts that switches from filtering requestedFiles to mapping Object.entries(loadedFiles), resolving normalized path mismatches across the common and agent-runtime packages.
ai.evidence: Diff in freebuff/cli/release/package.json changes "version": "0.0.92" to "version": "0.0.93"; analysis notes confirm this is a release-bump commit for Freebuff version 0.0.93 aggregating prior changes: 2026-05-16 removal of sublabel/descriptive paragraph in HomepageLiveStats (live-summary.tsx), and 2026-05-17 readfiles accepting absolute paths with updated result mapping in get-file-reading-updates.ts.

eli5.text: Freebuff 0.0.93 cleans up how live website statistics display on your homepage and makes the file-reading tool smarter and more flexible. The live stats panel no longer shows extra descriptive text and a redundant sublabel, so your homepage stats look simpler and less cluttered. You can now ask an agent to read files using absolute file paths (like the full folder location) instead of only short relative paths, so the tool works better when you give it any valid file location. This also fixes a behind-the-scenes mismatch where file results could come back in the wrong order or not match what was requested, making agent file operations more reliable and accurate.
